label: Fan display on the video (fan voltage x10)
definition_quote: Fan display: instantaneous fan voltagex10 on the video display. Maximum was 122, or 12.2 volts.

label: Radiometer on the video (uncalibrated, relative)
definition_quote: Radiometer gain: Uncalibrated radiometer gain, radiometer is displayed on the video. Adjusted to avoid saturation. Useful for relative flame intensity readings and flame dynamics (like pre-extinction oscillations). Video display data rate is 5 Hz.
